result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Company has affiliate and transaction-successor assignment rights without consent; Contractor remains subject to reasonably withheld consent and is absolutely barred from assigning to a Company competitor; and Company change of control creates no Contractor termination right. The drafting is clear and preserves the remaining mutual consent framework, including subcontracting. It is not strictly minimal because it also prohibits suspension and repricing upon Company change of control, protections beyond the playbook’s stated no-termination requirement.
